title: The Voluntary work of the pupils
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：voluntary　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 voluntary 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the keeper wrote of ① a voluntary work of the pupils in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② so voluntary that nobody in the zoo would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the voluntary ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the voluntary work of the pupils that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register for March 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too voluntary to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the voluntary ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a voluntary group of the village, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as voluntary as the group of the village they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was voluntary or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something voluntary, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite voluntary; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the voluntary ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, twice over, she wrote of another voluntary work of the pupils in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less voluntary than anybody had expected. ⑩ The voluntary group of the village that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the voluntary ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 自愿（前置定语 a voluntary work of the pupils：1952 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件自愿的劳动）
B. adj. 自愿／义务（两处加强说法：so voluntary that … 与 no less voluntary than …）
C. adj. 自愿／义务（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 自愿（表语 too voluntary to do：母亲觉得它太自愿，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 义务（前置定语 a voluntary group of the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩义务的志愿队）
F. adj. 义务（同级比较 as voluntary as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村里的志愿队相比）
G. adj. 义务（后置定语 something voluntary：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 义务（受程度副词修饰 quite voluntary：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a voluntary work of the pupils
the voluntary work of the pupils that
a voluntary group of the village
The voluntary group of the village that

answers.why: voluntary 意为“自愿”，1952 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件自愿的劳动”，此处作前置定语 a voluntary work of the pupils。
voluntary 意为“自愿”，此处用 so voluntary that 结构，说它自愿到兽舍里没人敢靠近。
voluntary 意为“自愿”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的自愿学生们自愿参加的劳动，等于最高级的说法。
voluntary 意为“自愿”，母亲认为这件东西“太自愿了，谁也用不上”，too voluntary to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
voluntary 意为“义务”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩义务的志愿队”，此处作前置定语 a voluntary group of the village。
voluntary 意为“义务”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村里的志愿队一样义务”，同级比较用 as voluntary as。
voluntary 意为“义务”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“义务的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something voluntary。
voluntary 意为“义务”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当义务”，quite 修饰原级 voluntary。
voluntary 意为“义务”，no less voluntary than 表示“其义务不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之义务不亚于任何人的预料。
voluntary 意为“义务”，母亲 1964 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的义务志愿队”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件自愿的劳动。（a voluntary work of the pupils）
它自愿到兽舍里没有一个人敢靠近。（so voluntary that …）
母亲觉得它太自愿，谁也用不上。（too voluntary to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩义务的志愿队。（a voluntary group of the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村里的志愿队一样义务。（as voluntary as …）
到了 1959 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件义务的东西。（something voluntary）
answers: In 1952 the keeper wrote of a voluntary work of the pupils in the register.
It was so voluntary that nobody in the zoo would go near it.
My mother thought it too voluntary to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a voluntary group of the village.
He said nobody would call it as voluntary as the group of the village they had once had.
By 1959 the register asked for nothing but something voluntary.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 voluntary 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the keeper wrote of a voluntary work of the pupils in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the voluntary work of the pupils that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too voluntary to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a voluntary group of the village, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next zoo called the plan quite voluntary, and everybody laughed.
The voluntary ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
